name: DGX Spark Fan Control
description: Set minimum fan-speed floors or a temperature-based performance curve on qualified DGX Spark systems.
compatibility: DGX Spark board P4242; Linux kernel module, hwmon, Python CLI, and optional systemd service.
limitations: Experimental; validated against specific NVIDIA kernel and EC firmware versions. Other GB10 variants are unverified.
Needs root access and a locally built/signed kernel module; Secure Boot requires certificate enrollment.
Sets minimums, not exact fan speeds. Hard crashes can prevent restoring automatic control, and manual floors have no expiry.

sources.note: Documents the listed workflow, requirements, compatibility, and limitations.
